summary: End-to-end validation of GTEX Coin Trader orders + One Wallet integration. Backend pytest: 22/22 pass (7 new tests in test_coin_traders_one_wallet.py + 15 regression in test_owner_console.py). Verified: (a) owner-console finance.wallet.gtex_total == /api/wallets/summary.available_balance == /api/wallet/summary.available_balance — one-wallet is wired. (b) Full user_buys cycle: create -> trader accept -> owner proof -> trader confirm releases coins into the owner wallet (pre 5.00 -> post 6.00 confirmed; exchange_activity grew from 10 to 12 earlier). (c) Full user_sells cycle with escrow: on trader accept available drops and reserved grows by the sold amount; after trader proof + owner confirm, reserved returns to 0 and available stays reduced. (d) Cancel on created orders returns status=cancelled. (e) Dispute on accepted orders returns status=disputed. (f) as_trader=true desk view returns the order to the trader. Frontend: admin@gtex.ng now lands on /app (regression from iteration_1 is FIXED), nav-admin visible, /app/admin reachable. Owner /app/finance renders balances with new 'Exchange & traders' stat, deposit-preview shows '₦900 per GTEX Coin' with LIVE PAYMENTS chip, coin-traders-panel renders with coin-trader-select / coin-direction-user_buys / coin-direction-user_sells / coin-amount-input / coin-order-preview / coin-order-submit and the submit creates a new coin-order-<uuid> card in my-coin-orders with cancel-order and dispute-order buttons; toast 'Order cancelled' confirms API success. All testids in the spec are present. No real Paystack checkout was completed.

minor.issue: Status after accept is 'payment_pending' (not previously listed in iteration_1 expected set); harmless but the state-machine's canonical status names should be documented.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. This is injected by the Emergent preview tooling (x-ve-dynamic spans) and does not affect functionality, but main agent may want to ensure the option children are plain strings so hydration is clean in prod builds.

critical_code_review_comments: Spec text in iteration_1 required 'cancel on created orders only'. UI currently renders both cancel-order-<id> (on status=created) and dispute-order-<id> (on ACTIVE/proof_submitted statuses) — this matches spec, no action.

One Wallet verified via two independent endpoints (owner finance + wallets/summary + wallet/summary) all return the same available_balance in COIN. Coin trader confirm uses repo wallet service -> gtex_total updates immediately; integration is sound.
Coin trader router endpoint /api/coin-traders/orders overloads semantics via ?as_trader=true. Consider /api/coin-traders/desk/orders for clarity (minor).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the tested surface (admin redirect, Finance balances, deposit preview, coin traders panel + submit + cancel + testid coverage)

test_credentials: flow7@gtex.test / FlowPass123! (owner, ~5 GTX wallet after test cleanup); admin@gtex.ng / GtexAdmin2026 (super_admin, routed to /app not /onboarding); demo.trader@gtex.ng / DemoTrader2026! (approved coin trader, rates buy ₦870 / sell ₦920).
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ coin trade orders in flow7's history (ids visible in UI with prefixes TEST_buy_, TEST_sell_, TEST_cancel_, TEST_dispute_); none required DB cleanup since cancelled/released. One UI-created buy order was cancelled during the UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend harness now has 22 tests in /app/backend/tests/. Owner console tests use flow7's live state (gtex_total/exchange_activity grow with every buy test; sell tests assume >=1 coin on hand and will skip otherwise). To replay: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini uses -n xdist by default and some tests mutate shared state so stick with single-worker). UI: use playwright locator().select_option() instead of page.evaluate for the trader <select> — children include ve-dynamic <span> wrappers that break naive JS evaluate. Coin traders panel is at /app/finance and selectors coin-traders-panel / coin-trader-select / coin-direction-{user_buys,user_sells} / coin-amount-input / coin-order-preview / coin-order-submit / my-coin-orders / trader-desk-orders / coin-order-<uuid> / accept-order-<id> / proof-input-<id> / submit-proof-<id> / confirm-order-<id> / cancel-order-<id> / dispute-order-<id> / balance-exchange_activity / deposit-preview are all present and functional.
